spells.notes: Caretaker holdover of the 김영삼 government into the 김대중 term (1998-02-25 .. 1998-03-03). The consent vote on 김종필 was aborted on 1998-03-02, and 고건 recommended (제청) the first 김대중 cabinet on the morning of 1998-03-03 before 김종필 was named 서리 the same afternoon. The OPM page gives 1998.03.02 as the last day. This roster uses 1998-03-03 because two same-week reports place him in office as incumbent PM on that day (same-day handover). Start 1997-03-05 is the 임명장 day. The Assembly consent passed on 1997-03-04 (likms 150475), so 1997-03-04 is possible if the 재가 preceded the ceremony. [verifier] The resignation was accepted on 1998-03-03, after he had recommended the first 김대중 cabinet (세계일보 1998-03-04). Nomination and consent were both on 1997-03-04 (likms 150475, 세계일보 and 매일경제 1997-03-05) and the 임명장 on the morning of 03-05 (한국일보 1997-03-06). The start stays 1997-03-05.

issues.desc: 국무총리실 (opm.go.kr) 역대총리 dates differ from the gazette or same-day news by one day in eleven places. They are 고건 end 1998.03.02 (news gives 1998-03-03), 박태준 end 2000.05.18 (사표 수리 05-19), 이한동 end 2002.07.10 (replaced 07-11), 김석수 end 2003.02.26, 고건 end 2004.05.24 (사표 수리 05-25), 한명숙 end 2007.03.06 (공식 사임·이임식 03-07), 한덕수 end 2008.02.28 (이임식 02-29), 한승수 end 2009.09.28 (이임식 09-29), 정세균 start 2020.01.13 in the header (profile and gazette 2020-01-14), 김부겸 start 2021.05.15 (gazette 05-14), 김민석 end 2026.6.30 (이임식 07-01). OPM usually lists the last full day before the successor. This roster follows the rule end = day the resignation was accepted or the day of replacement (same-day handover). Downstream code should treat same-day handovers as a one-day overlap, not a double tenure.

김종필 end date 2000-01-12 rests on the OPM page. He tendered his resignation on 2000-01-11 and 박태준 was appointed on 2000-01-13. No report of the acceptance date was found (BigKinds and Naver searches of 2000-01-11..13).

No PM left for the 2002-2026 local elections or the 2026-06-03 by-elections. 김민석 (2026) left for a party leadership race, coded resigned.

The first 이한동 motion (016115, lapsed 2000-05-29) and the two 이한동 특위 구성결의안 (016127, 016135) are cited in the 이한동 entry. 151132 (투표함개함동의) is cited in the 김종필 entry.
